2607.05458.title: Learning to Control LLM Agent Harnesses with Offline Reinforcement Learning
2607.05458.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are usually improved by changing prompts, models, or hand-written workflows, while the execution harness around the model is treated as fixed infrastructure. We argue that this harness is itself a learnable control layer. We formalize harness operation as a finite-horizon Harness MDP, where a lightweight controller selects structural execution actions while the LLM executor remains frozen. The controller is trained from offline rollouts using advantage-weighted regression with only terminal task-rubric rewards. We also separate final task quality from a post-hoc Harness Maturity Score, which measures whether the harness follows reliable execution patterns rather than only whether the final answer is correct. This separation gives a finite-buffer view of harness learning: final-quality gains require high-return support in the offline buffer, while process behavior can shift whenever it aligns with advantage-weighted actions. Across six controlled domains and two public-benchmark adapters, the learned controller consistently improves verification behavior and selectively improves final task quality, with the largest gains on adapted tau-bench retail, adapted AgentBench DB-Bench, and coding with a calibrated structural verifier. Ablations against behavior cloning and Forced CHECK show that the gains are not explained by imitation or by simply adding checks. These results identify harness control as a learnable layer for frozen LLM agents, while showing that offline support limits when better process control becomes better final answers.
2607.05458.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理通常透過改變提示、模型或手寫工作流程來進行改進，而模型周圍的執行環境則被視為固定基礎設施。我們主張這個環境本身是一個可學習的控制層。我們將環境的操作形式化為有限視野的環境馬可夫決策過程（Harness MDP），其中輕量級控制器在 LLM 執行者保持靜止的情況下選擇結構性執行動作。控制器通過使用優勢加權回歸從離線滾動中進行訓練，僅使用終端任務評分獎勵。我們還將最終任務質量與事後的環境成熟度評分分開，後者衡量環境是否遵循可靠的執行模式，而不僅僅是最終答案是否正確。這種分離提供了環境學習的有限緩衝視圖：最終質量的提升需要在離線緩衝區中獲得高回報支持，而過程行為則可以在與優勢加權動作對齊時隨時轉變。在六個受控領域和兩個公共基準適配器中，學習的控制器持續改善驗證行為並選擇性地提高最終任務質量，在調整過的 tau-bench 零售、調整過的 AgentBench DB-Bench 和使用經校準的結構驗證器進行編碼時獲得了最大的增益。針對行為克隆和強制檢查的消融實驗顯示，這些增益並不能通過模仿或僅僅添加檢查來解釋。這些結果確定了環境控制作為冷凍 LLM 代理的可學習層，同時顯示離線支持限制了何時更好的過程控制會轉變為更好的最終答案。
2607.05458.author: Haiwen Yi et.al.
